title: Should Pseudo-Labels Share Mini-Batches with Labeled Examples? Semi-Supervised Continual Active Learning with Limited Training Cost
abstract: arXiv:2610.35345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Active learning (AL) reduces annotation by querying informative examples. Continual active learning (CAL) also cuts the training cost, the total number of gradient steps, by training one model across AL rounds with a fixed number of mini-batch steps per round. Pseudo-labels add supervision without annotation, but they increase training cost. In CAL, where every round trains on a fixed number of mini-batches, whether and how pseudo-labeled examples should share these mini-batches with labeled examples is therefore open. We provide the first formalization of this problem as two decisions after each query, namely (i) which unlabeled examples should enter training with a pseudo-label and (ii) what share of each mini-batch they should take. Our method, semi-supervised continual active learning (SSCAL), works with any acquisition function. translated_title: 伪标签应该与标注样本共享小批量吗？训练成本受限的半监督持续主动学习
translated_abstract: 主动学习（AL）通过查询信息量大的样本来减少人工标注成本。持续主动学习（CAL）进一步降低训练成本（即总的梯度步数），其方式是在多轮主动学习过程中训练同一个模型，且每轮固定小批量训练步数。伪标签无需人工标注即可提供额外监督信号，但会增加训练成本。在持续主动学习中，由于每轮训练的小批量步数固定，伪标签样本是否以及如何与标注样本共享这些小批量成为一个悬而未决的问题。我们首次对该问题进行了形式化，将其描述为每次查询后的两个决策：(i) 哪些未标注样本应以伪标签形式进入训练；(ii) 它们应在每个小批量中占多大比例。我们提出的方法——半监督持续主动学习（SSCAL）——可适用于任意采集函数，该方法根据未标注样本与其已标注近邻之间的距离来决定是否采纳伪标签，并限制其占比。
tldr: 该论文首次形式化了持续主动学习中伪标签样本与标注样本如何共享小批量的训练问题，并提出SSCAL方法，在不增加训练成本的前提下有效利用伪标签，且兼容任意样本采集函数。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first formalization of how pseudo-labeled examples should share mini-batches with labeled examples in continual active learning, and proposes SSCAL, which leverages pseudo-labels without increasing training cost while being compatible with any acquisition function.
